title: Q-3: P2 Core tables in their own database
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/Q-3.json::Status:\*\* closed
**Status:** closed

Migrated from GitHub issue 3 (Issues are off on the code repository; this file is the record).

Move the core tables (agent_issues, issue_triage, work_claims, metric_registry, trust_ledger, decision_log, failure_modes, and the rest listed in core-manifest/boundary.json) out of QNFO's qnfo-audit database into a product database.

size: L

**Closing probe:** core tables exist in the product database and none of core-manifest/boundary.json tables are read from qnfo-audit.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 222.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
